Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: "FIXT.1.1" This must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: The length of the FIX message. This must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: The type of message. This must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: The sender's id, assigned by MEMX at on-boarding time.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: "MEMX"

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: The message sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: The time of message transmission in Universal Time coordinated. See UTCTimestamp in FIX 5.0 SP2 specification.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resent as a result of a ResendRequest. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: The message checksum. This must be the last field in the message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Required to be 0.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval, in seconds. An interval of 0 indicates there are no heartbeats. The maximum supported interval is 90 seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: MEMX will reject logon if this flag is 'Y'. MEMX Market Operations can reset the inbound and outbound sequence numbers on request.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: Required to be 9. ("FIX50SP2")

Field.Name: DefaultCstmApplVerID
Field.Description: The schema version, required as of version 1.9, is used to ensure consistency across message formats.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text explaining reason for logout.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Reference message sequence number.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field that was rejected.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message that was rejected.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Explanatory reason.

Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.
